messages.subject: Mentors: we need you to vote!
parts:
R/GSoC mentors,

We need you to vote! Now!

Your R GSoC program admins have less than 48 hours to make decisions
about slots.

We need as much input as possible from the mentor community to make
these decisions.

If one of your projects is there, I need you to comment on the
application using a private comment and select 'Wish to Mentor'.

Other Mentors: If you feel qualified to comment or vote on *any*
application, please do so.

We can't 'Accept' a proposal without a mentor assigned.

Regards,

Brian
